projects.name: LS Power generation assets and CPower acquisition
projects.quote: The transaction included 18 natural‑gas and dual fuel facilities totaling 13 GW across nine states and CPower's C&I demand response platform.

projects.name: Greens Bayou generation facility
projects.quote: On November 20, 2025, NRG entered into a $370 million loan agreement with the Public Utility Commission of Texas (PUCT) under the TEF for a low-interest rate loan at 3% to support development of its 443 MW Greens Bayou generation facility.

projects.name: T.H. Wharton
projects.quote: The Company expects commercial operations at the first project, T.H. Wharton, in June 2026.
